meta.title: DeepAI Code router
meta.description: Adds the DeepAI Code models to the model picker as the provider "DeepAI Code", including the virtual model "Auto (DeepAiCode)", and adds a Settings → DeepAI Code page for connecting the account. Auto answers with the most capable Frontier model the daily Theos allowance still covers, and switches automatically to another Frontier model — then to the unmetered 0-Theos models — whenever a model errors, is rate-limited, stalls, or runs out of allowance. Pick Auto (DeepAiCode) in the composer model picker or with /model; single models also appear individually, tagged with their Theos cost or as Unmetered. Connect, disconnect, paste an API key, read the remaining allowance and see recent fallbacks on the Settings → DeepAI Code page. The catalog is read from DeepAI Code on every start and again whenever a model fails, so models DeepAI adds appear without a plugin update; a published 27-model table is used until the first successful read. Sign-in uses the DeepAI browser flow and the resulting key is stored once in your DSH home; an existing DeepAI Code desktop sign-in or a DEEPAI_CODE_API_KEY environment variable is reused instead when present. Chat, streaming, reasoning traces and tool calls pass through, and each turn records which model actually served it. Limitations: this talks to an undocumented private endpoint of the DeepAI Code desktop client, so DeepAI can change it without notice; requests are billed to your account's own daily allowance and share it with the desktop app; images and files are not forwarded; and turning the plugin off removes the provider, its picker entries, the settings page and any routing state.
